stage.review_finding: The initial accounting finalizer could remove a completed Future from pending before its independent on_commit callback ran. A caller immediately starting shutdown could therefore race post-commit scheduling. Two successful-case immediate-delivery assertions failed on the initial patch; failed-worker cases correctly did not call on_commit.
stage.final_fix: Give the independent post-commit callback its own exactly-once guard and call it from caller cleanup only when the worker Future is done, after completion accounting. The same callback remains registered independently to deliver a late successful commit after timeout/cancellation. Neither worker slot nor callbacks are released for unfinished work.
